think_procedure: 1) Identify the knob’s type and normal operating range. 2) Check official PostgreSQL documentation for any sentinel/special values (e.g., -1, 0) that switch semantics (disable/auto/ignore). 3) Determine whether such a value makes the knob behave qualitatively differently than just ‘smaller/larger’. 4) If yes, mark as special and record the sentinel value(s); otherwise mark as not special.
